title: MaleTheme Solo #020 · 남 머슬 모델·피치 듀이·해적 테마·무늬
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the green stone terraces of Machu Picchu with stone steps of normal height and low terrace walls, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Thai man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, smooth golden-tan skin, a playful half-grin, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large brass hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on brass chain (a gold teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a lead round bell, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a lead miniature anvil, a tin ship's anchor, a bronze cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum necklaces. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black tricorn pirate hat with a white skull emblem, a red bandana knotted at his neck, black leather wrist cuffs with gold studs, and a minimal black leopard-print leather with gold leopard-print buckles T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme gold chunky platform boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
